rebalance.accepted: The preview above is the API's answer for the figures you entered.
rebalance.clientSupplied: Values supplied by you are unverified until the API reads your persisted positions.
rebalance.confirm: This preview does not execute anything.
rebalance.confirmNote: To act on it, place the orders through your trading screens.
rebalance.empty: No preview has been requested yet.
rebalance.executable: This preview does not place orders.
rebalance.intro: Enter the value each trader currently holds and the target weight for that trader. The API returns an exact preview and never creates an order or moves funds.
rebalance.invalidRow: Each allocation needs a trader identifier, a decimal current value and a target weight between 0 and 10000 basis points.
rebalance.invalidTotal: Enter the portfolio value as a decimal string such as 1000.00.
rebalance.previewNote: A preview is arithmetic on the figures shown here. It is not an order, not a transfer, and not a promise that the result can be executed at these values.
rebalance.stale: These figures changed after the preview was returned, so the preview no longer describes them.
rebalance.title: Allocation rebalance preview
rebalance.totalValue: Portfolio value used for the preview
